meta.purpose: Map pin coordinates for the schools in STB.SITES, plus the one operating receiving site. Names and statuses are NOT stored here — those live in the SITES array in assets/site.js, which stays the single source. This file only answers 'where does the pin go'.
meta.precision: Each entry carries a precision field. 'address' means the point is the school campus. 'borough' means no point is published and the pin is placed at a borough reference point rather than at a real address.
meta.verification_note: These coordinates were entered from publicly known school addresses and have NOT been checked against a geocoding service. Run tools/geocode.mjs to regenerate them from a live geocoder and overwrite this file before treating any pin as authoritative.

sites.name: Queens High School for the Sciences at York College
